ruleDefinitions.name: Screen Capture Activity Via Psr.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of Windows Problem Steps Recorder (psr.exe), a utility used to record the user screen and clicks.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\Psr\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/start.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-start.*")))
